show.description: Fake Girlfriend is a powerful drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Anika Malhotra, secretly the billionaire owner of Redrock, returns to India after ten years to reunite with her old love Ritwik, only to find him arrogant and greedy. When the truth of her identity shatters those who once humiliated her, Anika chooses self-respect, stands by true love, and redefines power on her own terms.
